qwen3.8-27b-iq3_xxs.notes: Dense Qwen3.8 27B (llama.cpp arch qwen35) from ISTA-DASLab's IQ3_XXS file, read in place by strata-poly with its 1,024-token vision and its draft block.  64K context on a 4-bit cache, measured on this host at 818.8 tok/s reading a 64K prompt and 55.7 tok/s writing. Calibrated for coding on this host (2026-11-02): temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, thinking budget 1536, loop recovery on; 7 of 7 code probes and 3 of 3 answer-only probes passed, and the repetition bait stopped on its own. Thinking modes off, low, medium and high are supported (default medium, thinking cap 4096); measured on this host 2026-11-02: every graded level passed all six probes on both files, off passed four of six and five of six, and the deep levels think most.
